title.narrative: Advanced business development services for improving the capacities of SMEs

description.narrative: Programme: Annual Action Programme for Montenegro 2020 Objective 2 ¿ Strengthening the Competitiveness and Innovation Capacity of the Private Sector of Montenegro (Financing Agreement concerning the Country Action Programme for Montenegro (2020) under the Instrument for Pre-Accession Assistance IPA II (2014-2020)).The overall objective (Impact) to which this action contributes is to strengthen the economic competitiveness of private sector in Montenegro.The specific objectives of this contract are to i) establish Business Development Services (BDS) for SMEs and ii) ensuring efficient absorption of EU financing programmes for SMEs
